issues.text: One pass is left. G1 and G2 are one class: 'inside the window' as the person can reach it. FX3 closes the whole class and is measured on 8 attacks, 2 benign twins and today's page, quiet and loaded. I propose the rework take FX3 in one step, G2 included, so the last pass is not spent on the next hole (AP-145).

The form of F2 that step 7b built is my own FX2 of pass 1. I measured it on TV05, M11b and TV06b only: never on a box narrower than the window, a box with hidden vertical overflow, or a clip, an overlay or a hidden button. So the hole G1 sat in my own proposal. Lesson for the journal (AP-145 kind): a gate that proposes a fix lists every place of the class and measures the fix on each, with a benign twin, before it writes the form.
